text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — slight agenda shuffle for today's all-hands. We need to move Roadmap Q&A to after the Legal session (legal needs the first 15). Also I noticed the recording test threw a dropped-frame warning.
Gabe: Ack. Moving roadmap later is fine. How long should we carve out for legal?
Maya: Let's give them 15 mins + 5 min buffer, so roadmap becomes ~30 mins later. I'll update the slide order.
Alex: I updated the agenda in Confluence: https://confluence/redwood/all-hands/today — roadmap now after Legal.
Samir: On recording — rehearsals showed ~2s audio drift when encoder hit 70% GPU. Might be GPU scheduling + OBS buffer.
Jamie: We need captions on from the start for accessibility. Last time captions lagged behind speaker. Can ops pre-warm the STT service?
ops-bot: streamer-health-check: encoder=OK, frames_dropped=3 (last 10m), audio_desync=possible, captions_service=warm=false
Maya: @ops-bot can you enable the fallback local recording if encoder drops? Also add a timestamp marker at start and end so post-prod can splice easier.
deploy-bot: command queued: 
```
/start-local-rec --device "Zoom USB" --out /mnt/recordings/allhands-1918001122.mp4 --marker start
```
Started local recording agent.
Samir: I'll watch the encoder metrics during call and be ready to switch. If we see >5% frame drops for 30s I switch to local-only and signal a 1-min pause.
Jamie: I'll prepare the opening script in case we need to stall for <2 mins. If longer, I'll read the prepared statement and note timing for edit.
Gabe: Suggestion: add a short blurb at the start telling attendees there may be a 1-min delay for captions — clears expectations.
Alex: Done — added slide 1.1 with a 10s notice and a quick caption status checkbox.
Maya: ACTIONS: ops pre-warm captions (Samir to trigger), Alex confirm agenda slide (done), Samir own recording file and upload to S3 after meeting, Jamie prep stall statement and handle comms if delay >2m.
Samir: I'll run the pre-warm now: `/api/v1/captions/warmup --model realtime-v2 --timeout 45s`
ops-bot: captions_warmup: started, expected_ready_in=30s
Jamie: :thumbsup: I'll be on standby in the lobby channel to coordinate Q&A handoffs.
Gabe: Who's handling notes for follow-ups? I can take action items from the recording markers.
Maya: Gabe please do notes. Samir upload and tag Gabe in the S3 link.
Alex: Small thing — can we also enable the auto-transcript so we have a quick search later?
Samir: Will enable auto-transcript post-upload: `transcribe --input allhands-1918001122.mp4 --lang en --out s3://redwood-allhands/transcripts/1918001122.vtt`
Maya: Great. Thanks everyone — fingers crossed for a clean run. If anything goes sideways, use this thread to flag and we'll switch to the contingency plan. :crossed_fingers:
